saints.name: Forty Martyrs of Sebaste
saints.legacy: Martyrdom and unwavering faith in Christ
saints.summary: The Forty Martyrs of Sebaste were soldiers who refused to renounce their Christian faith during the early 4th century. They endured a brutal execution by being left to freeze on a pond, steadfast in their belief and filled with joy at the prospect of martyrdom. Their unwavering commitment inspired others, including a guard who joined them in their faith just before their deaths.
